data.title: 苍崎青子 · 久远寺洋馆的黑胶唱片与手冲咖啡
data.description: 午后阳光斜照进久远寺洋馆的宽敞客厅。青子随性地席地坐在厚实的绒毛地毯上，一手托着下巴，一手端着香气扑鼻的手冲黑咖啡。身旁的复古黑胶唱片机流淌着慢板爵士乐，她带着大姐姐专属的洒脱微笑注视着你。
data.location: sunlit Kuonji mansion living room with plush floor rug and vinyl turntable
data.action: sitting on floor rug beside low coffee table, resting chin on hand, holding steaming coffee mug, relaxed elder-sister smile, gazing warmly at viewer
data.lighting: warm golden afternoon sunlight streaming through tall mansion windows
data.mood: cozy weekend leisure, intimate romantic warmth, nostalgic relaxed affection
data.promptProse: In the sunlit living room of Kuonji mansion, Aozaki Aoko sits relaxed on a plush floor rug beside a spinning vinyl record player, resting her chin on one hand while sipping warm pour-over coffee with an affectionate smile.
data.animaCaption: Resting her chin on one hand beside the spinning turntable, she sips warm coffee in the golden window sunlight.
data.identityProseOverride: Adult Aozaki Aoko from Witch on the Holy Night, a confident wandering magician with long red hair and blue eyes.
